newsitem.title: USA: National Vision adopts holder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: National Vision adopts holder rights plan.

text.p: National Vision Associates Ltd said on Friday its board of directors adopted a shareholder rights plan to provide the company with leverage in dealing with potential acquisitors.
The company said rights were not being distributed in response to any specific takeover attempt.
A dividend of one right per outstanding common share held as of the close of business on January 27, the company said.

The rights would not be exercisable until 10 days after a public announcement that a person or group has acquired 15 percent of the company's common stock, or under certain other conditions, National Vision said.
